answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the anchor graph is rebuilt each epoch, the karst merge is applied at settlement and the whisper audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 12 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
